_source: PROMPT draft texts, AIE_TEXT_PENDING (recovery/prompt/D4B-DEADLINE-WORDS-DRAFT.txt, 14 Oct). Replaced byte for byte by the AIE's texts before merge.
field_description: When the goal’s deadline is a calendar point rather than a number of months (for example the end of that quarter, by Q3, by March), copy the words that state that deadline VERBATIM from goal.source_quote, for example "by the end of that quarter". null when the deadline is a number of months, when the goal has no stated deadline, or when the words are a launch reference, runway, learning or measurement window rather than the goal’s deadline. These words are only used to ask the user which date is meant; they do not set a deadline.
